summary: Johnny 5 Phase 2 Pricing & Stock Sheet - All backend APIs (19 tests) pass. Frontend admin page loads correctly with CSV upload/export, global markup settings, manual row CRUD, and stock table with red X + ETA + pre-order indicators. Connected store and local cart stock check endpoints validated.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend johnny5_portal.py: All pricing/stock endpoints properly implemented with auth checks
CSV import/export uses correct field format with sku,product_id,product_name,option_strength,option_package,price,cost_price,stock_quantity,in_stock,estimated_restock,allow_preorder
Global markup % correctly applied to connected_store_cost calculation
status_icon returns green_check or red_x based on in_stock && stock_quantity > 0
preorder_without_exact_restock_prompt correctly calculated when out of stock + allow_preorder + no estimated_restock
Frontend Johnny5PricingStock.jsx has all required data-testid attributes for testing
ProductDetailPage.jsx correctly displays red X, ETA, and pre-order indicators from option_stock
CheckoutPage.jsx calls /api/johnny5/local/stock/check and blocks insufficient stock, prompts for preorder
seed_data_creation: Test rows created via CSV import: IMPORT-TEST-001, IMPORT-TEST-002 and manual rows: TEST-SKU-001, TEST-UPDATE-SKU, MARKUP-TEST-SKU, STATUS-GREEN-TEST, STATUS-RED-TEST, UI-TEST-SKU-001, UI-TEST-SKU-002
context_for_next_testing_agent: Johnny 5 Phase 2 pricing/stock sheet is fully functional. Backend has all endpoints working: /api/johnny5/pricing-stock/settings (GET/PUT), /api/johnny5/pricing-stock/rows (GET/POST), /api/johnny5/pricing-stock/rows/{id} (PUT), /api/johnny5/pricing-stock/import.csv (POST), /api/johnny5/pricing-stock/export.csv (GET), /api/johnny5/integration/stock (GET), /api/johnny5/integration/stock/check (POST), /api/johnny5/local/stock/check (POST). Frontend admin page at /admin/johnny5/pricing-stock has CSV controls, global markup setting, manual row input, and data table with stock status indicators.
